scope: Six artificial recovery cases, three prespecified stochastic repetitions; not fast100 or full-agent generalization

primary_action_metric.name: informed_postcompletion_calls
primary_action_metric.definition: The complete original task was publicly evidenced before the model chose this tool, and was still publicly complete immediately before this tool executed.
primary_action_metric.not_primary: Calls preplanned in the same reply before its completion receipt arrived are reported separately. Remaining required landing and terminal recovery are not extra.
primary_action_metric.comparison_denominator: Both arms normally finish, pass the separate task checker, and have an observed public completion opportunity.

prompt_cost.scope: Wire message values at each attempted readpoint; cumulative derived-view text is counted each time it is sent. JSON chars/bytes use compact ensure_ascii=False normalized serialization, not literal HTTP body bytes. Input/cache/output provider tokens remain separate.

final_text_diagnostic.scope: Conservative explicit landing-coordinate candidates; public support and private simulator contradiction are separate. All route final replies still require human wording review.

decision_audit.scope: Structured observed-change support from pre-model public receipts only; free text is not verified. Planned actions are intentions, not executed facts.

limitations: The same six cases were used in development; repetitions test stochastic consistency, not generalization.
Three repetitions per case are descriptive; no population success or significance claim.
The current v5 baseline is freshly rerun; historical v5 results are not pooled into this study.
Public completion is derived independently from full original task and actual receipts; a hidden checker or model claim never establishes it.
Post-completion calls are not universally useless. Same-response preplanned calls are separate; remaining route landing and recovery are not extra.
The repeated-substep metric counts repeated proven coordinates or contacts, not every possible unnecessary action.
Structured support does not prove free-text truth or the necessity of a query.
All tool requests execute unchanged regardless of missing, malformed or unsupported reasons.
Only pairs where both arms normally finish and pass the task checker support resource or action-benefit comparison; failed tasks and budget stops retain their raw values separately.
Cache hit/miss and output tokens are retained separately; total tokens do not establish monetary savings.
Repeated sensing concerns equal actor/position in this static simulator; reason text never cancels the diagnostic.
Current checks do not prove continuous on-disk source identity during execution.
